description: The bidi channel of 'evaluated under the supplying locale'. interpolateTemplate wraps caller-supplied placeholder values in isolate marks when shouldApplyBidiIsolation(locale, bidiIsolation) is true, and that `locale` is the donor (DefaultStrings.java:1367); interpolateFailureKey (DefaultStrings.java:754) is handed the REQUESTED locale instead. With the default BidiIsolation.RTL_LOCALES an Arabic request served by the English donor therefore gets no isolation, while the returned-key path for the same Arabic request does. Confirmed empirically against the oracle: the resolved Arabic-request translation is 'Hello, Sarah' with no U+2068/U+2069, while the returned-key one is 'Farewell.Named ⁨Sarah⁩'. Only en carries Greeting.Named; the key used by the returned-key cases exists in no catalog at all.
